tests.scope: Scalar/mock source and release checks plus tiny synthetic CPU tensors; no actual model, source arrays, GPU or process launch.

checks: Description-only default imports no scientific libraries and dispatches no helper/model/process. Explicit Linux execution required.

Both dataset modes bind exact frozen capacity and trainer source plus original scientific v1 and owned-process lifecycle hashes; no frozen source file changed. Private original run_host and initialization pairing bodies remain in use with dataset-correct C/B/T and verify_job/fixed_command callbacks.

Goop routes to Goop manifest, acquisition, context semantics, auxiliary census, four context source files and payload/config fields. Frame histories allow6..400; T401/type7/395000 eligible histories and official source/metadata/readers are checked. Sand paths/schema are not accepted as Goop.

Fixed fresh100000 training, base/mix by three seeds, A4/B2 mapping, batch2/threads2, checkpoint0+10k cadence and scalar log1/every100. No resume, capacity parent, stop-after or seed/policy reduction enters commands.
Training history checks all100k graph/schedule rows and exact sample/particle fields; logged LR recomputation allows one float64 ULP while paired saved schedules remain exact.

Checkpoint validator preserves exact architecture, finite float32 model/Adam values, nonnegative second moments, all optimizer100k steps, initial empty Adam and CPU/CUDA RNG bytes. Initial/final simulator configuration remains exact, without recomputing CUDA normalizers on CPU.

Six-job capacity q6/r6 remains actual Goop/Sand measured input as appropriate. Separate allocation adds11760s evaluation+cleanup,2700s cohort and3600s analysis plus justified ledger reserve. Original v1 forecast object remains unchanged and can retain null complete-fit fields.

Allocation requires fixed_execution_allocation_not_empirical_full_horizon_forecast, explicit no-completion-promise/no-v1-reinterpretation, and exact reviewed evaluation_quota_supervisor_sha256. Wrong evaluator quota hash fails in both datasets.

Root source/data/protocol/forecast/allocation/process/clock/Python hashes, same-host idle process/GPU evidence, clock error<=5 and freshness<=300s checked before launch and again after setup; copied/live source identities reverified before/after original loop.

Latest start and training stop preserve full planned remaining allocation and bounded owned cleanup. Original no-retry/exclusive-GPU loop, cheap reaping then heavy endpoint checks and post-child pairing audit retained.
Final worker success remains host-only; complete six-model cohort and reserved test release still require root cross-host review. All failed/partial attempts remain in owned fresh output.
review_adjustment: Added exact reviewed evaluation quota wrapper hash to the allocation contract, satisfying the science protocol binding without another execution gate.
reserve_accounting: 2700s cohort/preflight is charged once. Evaluation queue outer reserve covers still-needed outside work; normally3600s analysis after cohort/preflight is complete, plus any unfinished outside work. Do not double-reserve already-spent cohort work or omit work still pending.

ledger_1800_seconds_assessment.basis: Same 2D128-wide10-block model/Adam shapes,11publications,100k two-example graph records and A4/B2 filesystems as measured synthetic path. Goop context/provenance is configuration-level and frame-ID width remains comparable.1800/(1.35*11)=121.21s perpublication versus6.8s measured synthetic path plus earlier60s live-predicate allowance.
ledger_1800_seconds_assessment.limitations: Transferred allowance, not measured Goop100k publication runtime, probabilistic guarantee or worst-case bound. Final source/context checks must remain explicitly charged and actual overruns retained.

limits: This source review does not review/issue an actual scientific release or substitute for complete actual Goop numerical/capacity/initial-pairing evidence.
Raw capacity/checkpoint hashes and host overlap must be independently verified by root; source status predicates alone do not manufacture that evidence.
Quota allocation guarantees neither model convergence nor complete evaluation; missing/failed required outcomes leave complete-sample scientific contrasts null.
The root must execute the reviewed evaluation queue, perform binary/array/final paired audits and preserve all adverse results; no conference-readiness claim follows.
